name: unsharp_filter_ablation
description: Evaluated 6 unsharp strengths (alpha 0.0 to 0.25) across 1600 held-out OOF images
primary_metrics: alpha=0.00: PSNR=25.33dB SSIM=0.7885 Sharp=0.3451 Q_FR=0.6218; alpha=0.10: PSNR=25.24dB SSIM=0.7883 Sharp=0.4118 Q_FR=0.6263; alpha=0.25 (V25): PSNR=24.95dB SSIM=0.7850 Sharp=0.5193

name: multiscale_and_flip_tta
description: Evaluates single 1024 no-flip vs flip vs 2-scale [1024, 1152] vs 3-scale [896, 1024, 1152]
primary_metrics: single_1024_noflip: Q_seg=0.2430 (87ms); single_1024_flip: Q_seg=0.2801 (166ms); two_scale_flip: Q_seg=0.2594 (367ms); three_scale_flip: Q_seg=0.2805 (491ms)
delta_vs_baseline: single_1024_flip: +0.0371 Q_seg (+15.3% relative gain, +0.145 Macro IoU); multi-scale: negligible delta (+0.0004) with 3x latency penalty
notes: Single-scale Horizontal-Flip TTA (1024x1024) is the clear Pareto-optimal choice. Multi-scale rejected due to latency overhead with zero meaningful gain.
